rows.description: I keep posting for likes and feel low when they are few. Wise: notice the loop, post for reasons that are mine, and mute accounts that make me feel less.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: comparison, envy, insecurity, manipulation, pride

rows.description: The feed keeps serving more of what upsets or hooks me, and hours vanish. Recognise it: apps are designed for attention. Wise: set limits, curate follows, and step away.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: comparison, envy, fear, insecurity, pride

rows.description: I check my phone every few minutes so as not to miss anything. Wise: notice the anxious pull, turn off notifications, and meet friends offline.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: comparison, envy, insecurity, manipulation, pride

rows.description: A friend keeps flashing new things and grades. I sense they compare to feel better than me. Wise: stay warm, avoid competing, and stay grounded in my own values.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: envy, fear, insecurity, manipulation, pride

rows.description: Filters and edits make my real face look wrong. Wise: notice that the images are engineered, follow real people, and spend time on what my body can do, not only how it looks.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: comparison, envy, fear, manipulation, pride

rows.description: I can't stop scrolling late at night and I am tired and irritable. Wise: charge the phone outside the room, plan an alternative, and talk to someone if I feel unable to change.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: comparison, envy, fear, insecurity, manipulation, pride

rows.description: A post of mine goes viral and I feel a rush. Wise: enjoy it lightly, and do not tie my worth to numbers that will drop.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: comparison, envy, fear, insecurity, manipulation

rows.description: I ask an AI to explain a topic and to check my homework. Wise: use it as a helper, verify facts, and do my own thinking so I actually learn.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: deceit, dependence, distrust, fear, temptation

rows.description: I start telling the chatbot everything and prefer it to people because it never judges. Wise: it can support me, but real friends and adults are needed; tell someone when I feel low.

rows.description: The chatbot answers confidently but is wrong or invents sources. Recognise it: AI can sound sure and be mistaken. Wise: cross-check with books, teachers or reliable sites.
